listing.aiSummary: Adds a maintained version of the Kadur Remnant faction mod for Starsector 0.98a-RC8.

description:
Hello! I have obtained permission to bring Kadur Remnant into a relative 0.98a-RC8 support! However, these changes may or may not reflect Vayra's intent, but I hope it makes the Kadur Remnants more playable and brings a better experience!

Two colonies, both alike in zealotry,

in fair Mirage-Truth, we lay our scene...

-Original and more detailed information on the faction here-

-Also my older maintenance post-

A "True" and ""Accurate"" History of the Kadur Remnants

Entry Log

Details

The Gate System and Human Domain

Colonization of Domain settlers reached the Mirage-Truth system: Kadur, a desert planet, is recognized for its high mineral values and established as a mining colony, whereas Oasis, another desert planet, becomes a candidate for agricultural terraforming as a farming colony.

The Mirage-Truth System pre-Collapse

Over time, cultural tensions between the two polities grew, but an uneasy peace due to their mutual reliance developed. Domain authorities use this tension to prevent the two colonies from uniting in disobedience. To further solidify the idea, Domain establishes an orbital dockyard on Kadur to the outrage of both polities in an attempt to show favoritism to divide.

The Collapse

The colonies of Kadur and Oasis attack each other, blaming one another for the Collapse. Domain authorities quell the attack with brutal violence. Civil disobedience and later open rebellion begin in both worlds.

Early Post-Collapse

Eventually, in an unprecedented move, both insurgency on the colonies unite and seize power from the Domain authorities. A new state of Kadur Theocracy is formed, where much of the political power lies within Kadur. A christened Kadur Defense Force valiantly defends the Mirage-Truth system from piracy and corporate opportunists. The Church of Galactic Redemption and a battlegroup's proclamation of hegemony only reinforce the Theocracy's isolationist practices. Amidst the chaos of the Collapse, the Kadur Theocracy becomes a bastion for neutral starfarers seeking safety and refuge as long as they are willing to convert to the Kadur faith.

Forever War Engineering

, rushed designs of the current Domain's garrison, originates and makes up a majority of Kadur ships.

The First AI War

Taking advantage of the chaos in the Persean Sector and prompted by the attack on Mairaath, the Theocracy begins to restore the construction of two Domain ships that began pre-Collapse without interruption and suspicions amongst the major powers of the Persean Sector.

Guardian Engineering

, an original Kadur design, originates around this time period.

AI War Interbellum

Qamar, the moon of Kadur, begins an insurgency over opposing views between the Theocracy leadership.

The Harrowing

takes place, exiles within Kadur ranks. The two Domain ships are finalized and restored, which guarantees the independence of the Kadur Theocracy.

The Second AI War

No surviving records.

(c+196.02.14)

Hegemony scouts spotted on the day of an old Earth festival, they are met respectively by a vigilant defense force.

K1 Paladin's Vigil (Mission)K2 Tactical Retreat (Mission)

(c+196.10.15-17)

Hegemony attacks the Kadur Theocracy. Kadur is annihilated. Hegemony is victorious and takes control of the Mirage-Truth system.

K3 Defenders of the Faith (Mission)K4 Operation Godslayer (Mission)K5 Operation Breadbasket (Mission)K6 Exodus (Mission)

The Present Era

With the theocrats gone and remnants of Kadur scattered across Persea, it begs the question. Will they be extinguished or reborn?

K7 Unbowed (Mission)

Features

Quote from: Vayra on September 14, 2013, 05:31:11 AM

Faction strengths:
High straight-line speedHigh alpha strike damageLong-ranged ballisticsHigh hull strength and armorGood forward-facing firepowerDamn the torpedoes, full speed ahead
Faction weaknesses:
Inefficient and generally front-fixed shieldsTerrible maneuverabilityLittle access to energy weaponsExposed engines and few rear-facing mountsReliance on armor over shields causes the Kadur to fare poorly in sustained engagementsExtremely vulnerable to agile, flanking enemies or overextending
This mod is compatible with utilities, faction mods, ship/weapon packs, Nexerelin, and other non-Total Conversion content mods, and does not require Vayra's Sector, though it does integrate with Vayra's Sector to add additional content when enabled alongside it.

Content

Quote from: Vayra on September 14, 2013, 05:31:11 AM

Show Me the Ships
SpoilerFrigates

Mendicant-class Shuttle - The Mendicant is a Kadur light personnel and supply hauler, well-protected for a civilian ship but still far from a proper combat frigate.
Hyena-class Light Frigate - The Hyena has incredible speed, but only light armor and limited outfitting options. A good pursuit ship or light harasser.
Buzzard-class Frigate - The Buzzard mounts a weapon package that some would consider excessive for a frigate, but suffers from a lack of ordnance capacity with which to take advantage of it. Advanced targeting systems make it an excellent close or fire support vessel.
Camel-class Heavy Frigate - The Camel combines Destroyer-grade armor and hull strength with Frigate-level agility. Excels in an assault role, but can also hold its own in a battle line.
Dolphin-class Combat Tug - Little more than a set of Cruiser-scale engines affixed to the rear of a solid wedge of armor plating, the Dolphin has incredible survivability for a tug - even when driven full-speed into an opponent's bulkheads.

Destroyers

Sunbird-class Missile Destroyer - The Sunbird is an aggressive missile ship with the ability to regenerate ammunition, if allowed to do so unopposed. Good as fire support or a torpedo strike craft.
Shirdal-class Light Carrier - The Shirdal is a combat-capable light carrier, boasting two modular flight decks and decently well-armed - though fitting it for both fighter support and front-line combat may be asking a little much of it.
Falchion-class Light Destroyer - The Falchion is a fast and lightweight destroyer, capable of darting in to deal damage from unexpected angles with its forward-focused ballistic weaponry. Of limited use in a sustained engagement.
Archimandrite-class Destroyer - The Archimandrite mounts an oversized weapon in its main forward battery, and backs it up with some light ballistic firepower and an overdrive system. Great as an artillery or assault ship, but vulnerable to being flanked.
Targe-class Heavy Destroyer - The Targe is slow, but mounts a formidable set of ballistic batteries and can temporarily overcharge them for even more firepower. Excellent in a battle line, or assaulting targets pinned down by faster craft.

Cruisers

Sirocco-class Supply Ship - The Sirocco is the primary Kadur logistics ship, carrying prodigious amounts of fuel and cargo and still mounting enough weapons to deter pirates and raiders.
Falcon (K) class Light Cruiser - Built from the original MPC captured long ago by the Kadur Theocracy, their version of the Falcon trades the original's sturdy shields and hybrid weaponry for a pair of missile-capable mounts and heavier armor. Good for fire support or strike duty.
Eagle (K) class Cruiser - Akin to the Kadur Falcon, the Eagle (K) trades high-capacity shielding and energy mounts for heavier plating and all-ballistic assault batteries. An excellent heavy assault craft, or passable gunline combatant.
Golden Eagle class Cruiser - The aptly named Golden Eagle is an up-sized and up-gunned version of its smaller siblings. Replacing the Mass-Aug Ram Jets of the Eagle and Falcon (K) with an overdrive system, it is capable of dramatically increasing its speed, maneuverability, and flux handling for short periods of time. Strong as a fast attacker or gun platform, and a good choice to fly personally.
Rukh-class Fast Carrier - The Rukh is fast enough to deliver strike craft wherever they're needed on the battlefield, but lacks maneuverability or strike weapons of its own. Specialized C&C systems greatly increase the effectiveness of its fighter wings in a dogfight.
Golem-class Heavy Cruiser - Slow but heavily armed and armored, the Golem is a purpose-built anvil for the hammer of the rest of the Kadur fleet to smash their enemies upon. Carries a terrifying array of heavy weapons in mounts that can be overclocked for even more firepower, at the cost of anything approaching mobility. Excels at gunline combat and fleet anchor duty.
Sphinx-class Heavy Cruiser - The heaviest cruiser-class warship deployed by the Kadur Remnant, the Sphinx is a devastating assault and line vessel. Capable of facing down most other craft in the sector and coming out on top, but vulnerable to flanking attacks and sustained pressure.

Capitals

Ziz-class Battlecruiser - The Ziz is a fast light capital, relatively lightly armored but not lacking in firepower. Twin large missile mounts and an overdrive system give it the power to excel at chasing down cruisers and pouncing on vulnerable enemy capitals, but it will fare poorly under sustained pressure.
Seraph-class Battlecarrier - Purpose-built to act as a force equalizer against hostile fleet carriers and battleships, the Seraph mounts anti-capital weaponry and provides anti-fighter support via its experimental Mass-Anomaly Field ship system - which notably, affects all strike craft not launched by itself or smaller Kadur dedicated carriers. A wise commander will field only one or two Seraphs at a time, and ensure they are deployed far from both each other and any additional friendly carriers or ships with converted hangars in the battlespace.
Prophet-class Battleship - The Prophet is a true leviathan, bristling with heavy guns and well-protected behind thick armor plating but ponderous in its movements. Demands fleet escorts to keep its flanks clear, but can fight nearly any other ship in the sector when properly supported. An excellent anchor for a battle line, no matter the foe.

aiDescription: This mod brings the Kadur Remnants faction into relative 0.98a-RC8 support, featuring a theocratic empire with high straight-line speed, heavy armor, and long-ranged ballistics. It includes a wide variety of ships, weapons, and missions, along with integration for Nexerelin and Vayra's Sector utilities.

changelog.3.2.4support2:
Fixed Caliph's Engine not limiting engine stats when destroyed/disabled
Caliph's PPT is unlimited.
Caliph turns better, slightly. Only noticeable when the officer on the Caliph lacks Helmsmanship.
Qamar Mendicant has Smart Flares (base Mendicant has regular Flares)
Qamar Mendicant no longer has Safety Override (to be consistent with Prophet's Guardian Engineering with Qamar design) for Auxiliary Thrusters and Resistant Flux Conduit
Added Qamar version of the Falcon, Archimandrite, Falchion, and Hyena
Qamar Patrols should have fewer Kadur ships and more of its Qamar equivalent.
K5 buffs (because the reinforcements are different now)
K7 buffs (should be consistently easier to complete it [reducing the amount of carriers])
Added K8 Mission (and its reward being certain ship blueprints)
changelog.3.2.4support1:
Fixed Caliph's Engine flares not firing.
Gyrojet Launcher is now a Composite (Missile) from Ballistic
Updated mission
Heavy Weapon Integration only affects ballistics and energy weapons.
Seraph's ship system no longer increases fighter damage taken, but increases its lightning EMP damage by +50 (this also increases game performance when using it)
Fixed IndEvo's interaction with Tortuga Station having too many industries (this one requires a new save)
changelog.3.2.4support:
Caliph
+ Fixed the Caliph's Shield randomly appearing on a thin line when the generator blows up.
Overall Ships
+ Fixed some ship variants
+ Made the wording of Guardian and Forever War Engineering easier to read (the old description would be in the Codex entries now)
Multirail Assault Splintergun
+ Burst Size 20 -> 10
+ Reload/sec 20 -> 10
Kadur Missions
- Not sure if important but maybe someone might appreciate it...
- K2's surviving ships from K1 mission have reduced CR.
+ K3 removed officers for enemy cruisers (only their capital ships have it but they still benefit from Support Doctrine)
+ K4 removed Caliph's officer, added more hegemony escorts, reduced enemy escorts.
+ K5 removed Caliph's officer.
+ Reworked K6's reinforcement system and reduced the lag generated during late game.
- Some other stuff too, but forgot to document.
Misc changes
* Put Kadur's blueprints as codex lockable, Caliph as codex lockable, and some other stuff, I do not remember all of it.
+ Substandard Shield Generator (Falcon [K] and Eagle[K]) is now a dmod that can be restored.
Perdition Outpost
- Removed Moderate Ore and Sparse Rare Ore Deposit, loses Mining
- Removed Ground Defenses
- Gains Very Cold (since it seems to be present in all Black Holes System)
+ Removed Decivilized Subpopulation
Tortuga Station
- Size reduced from 6 to 5.
- Megaport reduced to regular spaceport.
- Removed Refining and Light Industry
- Gains Very Cold (since it seems to be present in all Black Holes System)
Star Fortress Requiem
- Gains Very Cold (since it seems to be present in all Black Holes System)
- Downgraded its Pristine Nanoforge to Corrupted Nanoforge (damaged during the escape)
* Removed Kadur Hardened Populace; moved bonus to Kadur Holy Fleet HQ
* Removed its farmland condition because hydroponic complex now works properly in providing food
+ (Nexerelin) Increased the graceful period of not being invaded to 3 years from 2 years.
+ Kadur Majority Faithful now provides +1 production to all industrial industries (Mining and Heavy Industry specifically)
Fort Toxx/Kadur
- Size reduced from 3 to 2.
- Replaced Heavy Industry with Tech-Mining
- Added Decivilized Subpopulation
- Now a part of Kadur (Fort Toxx is the name of its Orbital Station)
- (Nexerelin) Kadur Remnants will not even considering touching for reclaiming until their "Crusade" fleet has returned (6 years grace period)
Oasis
- Reduced Rich Farmland to Adequate (Soil Nanites should be carrying the work in Food Export as lore)
Gestalt (the Caliph)
* Replaced some graphics on how it's seen on the map... not too pretty but it's more accurate at least!
* Removed Kadur Hardened Populace; moved bonus to Qamar Insurgency HQ
+ Kadur Majority Faithful now provides +1 production to all industrial industries (Mining and Heavy Industry specifically)
Qamar
+ Added Scattered Ruins
